# Saddlewood Contracting

> Saddlewood Contracting — a Paradise Valley, AZ design-build home remodeling contractor. Four Arizona ROC licenses (General Contractor, HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing); all major trades and the structure performed in-house.

## Services
- luxury kitchen remodels
- spa-grade bathrooms
- whole-home renovations
- outdoor living spaces

## Areas served
- Paradise Valley
- Scottsdale
- McCormick Ranch
- Arcadia
- Silverleaf
- DC Ranch
- Grayhawk
